answer: Audits are recorded in hollow, queued in willow, and vault publishes the wait time. A farm of 249 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 36 identities per epoch. A farm of 4027 identities would post 3868 proofs and burn roughly 87 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
